title: Umami - Site detail
description: Content, engagement, performance, and audience for one tracked site. Pick the site at the top.

list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.definition: SELECT domain AS __text, website_id::text AS __value FROM website WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY domain
list.query: SELECT domain AS __text, website_id::text AS __value FROM website WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY domain

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT session_id) AS "visitors" FROM website_event WHERE website_id = ${site:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT count(*) AS "pageviews" FROM website_event WHERE website_id = ${site:sqlstring} AND event_type = 1 AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE pv = 1) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS "bounce" FROM (SELECT visit_id, count(*) AS pv FROM website_event WHERE website_id = ${site:sqlstring} AND event_type = 1 AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1) v

SELECT round(avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM span))) AS "avg_seconds" FROM (SELECT visit_id, max(created_at) - min(created_at) AS span FROM website_event WHERE website_id = ${site:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1) v
SELECT count(*) AS "events" FROM website_event WHERE website_id = ${site:sqlstring} AND event_type = 2 AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: 404s
panels.description: page-404 events, sent only when the site renders its not-found page.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "not_found" FROM website_event WHERE website_id = ${site:sqlstring} AND event_name = 'page-404' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

SELECT $__timeGroup(created_at, $__interval) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 1) AS "pageviews", count(DISTINCT session_id) AS "visitors" FROM website_event WHERE website_id = ${site:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top pages
panels.description: Ranked by pageviews. Entry and exit counts show which pages start and end a visit.

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.url_path AS "Path", count(*) AS "Views", count(DISTINCT e.session_id) AS "Visitors" FROM website_event e WHERE e.website_id = ${site:sqlstring} AND e.event_type = 1 AND $__timeFilter(e.created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT url_path AS "Path", count(*) AS "Entries" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (visit_id) visit_id, url_path FROM website_event WHERE website_id = ${site:sqlstring} AND event_type = 1 AND $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY visit_id, created_at) t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT url_path AS "Path", count(*) AS "Exits" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (visit_id) visit_id, url_path FROM website_event WHERE website_id = ${site:sqlstring} AND event_type = 1 AND $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY visit_id, created_at DESC) t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Scroll depth
panels.description: Page loads that reached each milestone, as a share of pageviews. Explains bounce rate better than bounce rate alone.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ed.number_value::int || '%' AS "Depth", count(DISTINCT ed.website_event_id) AS "Page loads", round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT ed.website_event_id) / nullif((SELECT count(*) FROM website_event WHERE website_id = ${site:sqlstring} AND event_type = 1 AND $__timeFilter(created_at)), 0), 1) AS "Share of pageviews" FROM event_data ed WHERE ed.website_id = ${site:sqlstring} AND ed.data_key = 'depth' AND $__timeFilter(ed.created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Page types
panels.description: From the page-type event. Tells you what kind of content earns attention, not just which URL.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ed.string_value AS "Type", count(*) AS "Events", count(DISTINCT e.session_id) AS "Visitors" FROM event_data ed JOIN website_event e ON e.event_id = ed.website_event_id WHERE ed.website_id = ${site:sqlstring} AND ed.data_key = 'type' AND $__timeFilter(ed.created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Search terms
panels.description: Terms visitors typed into the site search. High-volume terms are missing content.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ed.string_value AS "Term", count(*) AS "Searches" FROM event_data ed WHERE ed.website_id = ${site:sqlstring} AND ed.data_key = 'term' AND $__timeFilter(ed.created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT coalesce(ed.string_value, 'unknown') AS "Domain", count(*) AS "Clicks" FROM event_data ed WHERE ed.website_id = ${site:sqlstring} AND ed.data_key = 'domain' AND $__timeFilter(ed.created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT coalesce(ed.string_value, e.url_path) AS "File", count(*) AS "Downloads" FROM website_event e LEFT JOIN event_data ed ON ed.website_event_id = e.event_id AND ed.data_key = 'file' WHERE e.website_id = ${site:sqlstring} AND e.event_name = 'file-download' AND $__timeFilter(e.created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT coalesce(e.referrer_domain, 'direct') AS "Referrer", count(DISTINCT e.session_id) AS "Visitors", count(*) AS "Pageviews" FROM website_event e WHERE e.website_id = ${site:sqlstring} AND e.event_type = 1 AND $__timeFilter(e.created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Core Web Vitals per page (p75)
panels.description: Pages with more than 2 samples. Sort order is LCP, slowest first.

targets.rawSql: SELECT url_path AS "Path", count(*) AS "Samples", round(percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lcp) FILTER (WHERE lcp IS NOT NULL)) AS "LCP p75", round(percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY inp) FILTER (WHERE inp IS NOT NULL)) AS "INP p75", round((percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cls) FILTER (WHERE cls IS NOT NULL))::numeric, 3) AS "CLS p75", round(percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ttfb) FILTER (WHERE ttfb IS NOT NULL)) AS "TTFB p75" FROM website_event WHERE website_id = ${site:sqlstring} AND event_type = 5 AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) > 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT event_name AS "Event", count(*) AS "Count", count(DISTINCT session_id) AS "Sessions", to_char(max(created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "Last seen" FROM website_event WHERE website_id = ${site:sqlstring} AND event_type = 2 AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT coalesce(device, 'unknown') AS "Device", coalesce(browser, 'unknown') AS "Browser", count(*) AS "Visitors" FROM session WHERE website_id = ${site:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT coalesce(nullif(trim(country), ''), 'unknown') AS "Country", count(*) AS "Visitors" FROM session WHERE website_id = ${site:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20
